description_en: Queries the results of NIS traffic ranking analysis
description_zh: 查询NIS流量排序分析结果
name: DescribeNisTrafficRanking

parameters.help_en: The ID of the traffic ranking analysis result. Set this parameter to the value returned by the StartNisTrafficRanking operation
parameters.help_zh: 流量排序分析结果 ID，根据StartNisTrafficRanking接口返回进行传入
parameters.name: nis_traffic_ranking_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值范围：1~100，默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results
